title: SIS Dual Gadget Trapdoor A = [G | -G R mod 2^t] Binary Witness Compilation
claims: For any gadget header A = [G | -G R mod 2^t] with binary trapdoor R in {0, 1}^{(nt) x m}, T = [[R], [I_m]] in {0, 1}^{K x m} satisfies A T == 0 (mod 2^t) with zero carry defect on the all-zero syndrome branch.
Puncturing a single active gadget bit idx = i*t + r from column t_j and applying Pauli-X sign rectification isolates the exact canonical dyadic scale +2^r e_i (mod 2^t).
favorable_controls: 2D Z_8^2 (n=2, t=3, K=8) gadget trapdoor extracting all 6 dyadic scales
